title: Crawford: AI's material three-body stack
summary: Every AI system coordinates three material bodies: resource extraction, computational infrastructure and human labor. The output marketed as 'intelligence' externalizes environmental and social costs; with minimal accountability the machines do exactly what they are told while the human and ecological context is devastated.
source: Ch06 — 'Every query you send to ChatGPT coordinates your question with server farms... with rare earth mines in Congo... with underpaid content moderators.'

nodes.label: Externalized Costs
nodes.description: Environmental damage and exploited labor left off the books

nodes.label: Material Accountability
nodes.description: Coordination of technical progress with sustainability and justice

edges.description: Mined materials and energy build and run the infrastructure
Infrastructure trains and serves the model
Ghost workers label and moderate what the model learns from
Production rises while environmental and social costs are excluded from the model
Accountability would force costs back into the accounts

identifiability_note: Every node is observable through supply-chain and energy audit; the absent piece is accountability, not data.
